# Theme contract reference

<!-- GENERATED by tools/sync.py from contract/vehicle.slint. Do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Source: ola-dash-sdk at 7e3f339b2cde5ccc7adbb3061edf5e0924991e10. contract-version 5. -->

The contract is `contract-version: 5`. Themes read `in` properties and invoke the callbacks listed here. The host writes `in` properties. Themes must never assign to them.

Units come from name suffixes: `-kmh` km/h, `-km` km, `-pct` %, `-c` degC, `-a` A, `-v` V. `-1` means not reported yet. Show `--`.

## Header comment of the contract file

> Ola Dash SDK theme contract.
>
> The host app writes `in` properties; themes only read them and may invoke the
> allowlisted callbacks. Rules for changing this file (see docs/contract.md):
> - additive only: never rename or remove a field, enum value or callback;
> - append new enum values at the end;
> - bump `contract-version` and add a line to the history below.
> The host wraps each theme and re-exports these globals, so a theme's main.slint
> only needs to export `Dash`.
>
> History: v2 park, reverse | v3 custom, hyper-available | v4 easy-park |
> v5 VehicleState, Battery, Ride, Navigation, Plugins; -1 = not reported yet

## Enums

### `DriveMode`

`eco`, `normal`, `sport`, `hyper`, `unknown`, `park`, `reverse`, `custom`, `easy-park`

### `VehicleState`

Vehicle power state as reported by the BCM. sleep: locked, ECUs off | idle: woken while locked | park: unlocked, not ready | drive: ready to ride | charging: charger session active.

`unknown`, `sleep`, `idle`, `park`, `drive`, `charging`

### `Regen`

`none`, `coast`, `brake`
